item.title: Game Theoretical Models and Applications SING21
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks to advance research on game theory as a framework for understanding strategic interaction, cooperation, conflict, and decision-making in complex systems. The collection emphasizes recent theoretical developments and diverse applications, particularly focusing on interaction dynamics and collective decision-making through both theoretical and practical contributions.

The issue particularly welcomes expanded and revised versions of papers presented at the European Meeting on Game Theory 2026 (SING21), though other relevant submissions are also encouraged. All papers undergo rigorous peer review by guest editors, with accepted contributions published online before appearing in print.

Appel publié par Annals of Operations Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
